import sys, json, subprocess, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *
# ~31MB input: 6400 events x ~4.8KB hex
big_body = b"x" * 2000
req = mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=big_body) + [("P-Preferred-Identity","<sip:desk@lab.test>,<tel:+12025550100>"),("Privacy","id"),("X-Junk","y"*200)], body=big_body)
evs = [ev(i, "edge", "alice", "external", req.hex()) for i in range(6400)]
raw = json.dumps(envelope(evs, base_config(cap=10000))).encode()
print("input MB:", len(raw)/1e6)
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', MAIN], input=raw, capture_output=True)
print("rc", p.returncode, "time", round(time.time()-t0,2))
usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("peak child RSS MB:", usage.ru_maxrss/1024)
d = json.loads(p.stdout)
print("accepted", d["accepted"], "live", d["live"], "out MB", len(p.stdout)/1e6)
EOF
